_doc: Retail listings for Equihash ASICs. Prices, stock, delivery and batch wording are copied from approved vendor product pages and refreshed daily when a page passes its parser and validation rules. A failed or blocked fetch preserves the last good record. equihash.com has no checkout and receives no seller payment.

listings.title: ANTMINER Z15 Pro 840KSol
listings.hashrate_note: Manufacturer figure: 840 kSol/s and 2,780 W typical.
listings.shipping_note: BITMAIN's shop shows this batch sold out. Delivery availability and charges depend on the checkout destination.

listings.shipping_note: UK delivery included. The product page describes DDP delivery from a UK/EU warehouse.
listings.image_license_note: Product photo reproduced from the vendor listing page.

listings.title: Antminer Z15 Pro 840KSol
listings.hashrate_note: Shop states 840 kSol/s, 2,780 W and 3.31 J/kSol.
listings.shipping_note: Ships from Breda. The €8,599 option is shown for January/February; the shop states worldwide delivery. Import duties and local taxes apply outside the EU unless agreed otherwise.

listings.title: Antminer Z15 Pro 860KSol — fast dispatch option
listings.hashrate_note: Seller advertises an 860 kSol/s option. BITMAIN publishes 840 kSol/s ±3% as the typical specification; require the exact unit test report and firmware/model details.
listings.availability_label: Seller advertises dispatch in seven days
listings.shipping_note: Ships from Breda. Dispatch wording is not physical allocation or serial proof. Confirm the selected units, invoice beneficiary, insured freight and destination taxes in writing.
